raw_snippet: Meta has committed to purchase additional available compute capacity across certain upcoming Nebius clusters up to a total of $15 billion over a five-year period
note: Meta obliged to buy Nebius's unsold capacity on named clusters, up to US$15B over 5 years; "up to" at face; same shape as the CoreWeave-Nvidia unsold-capacity row. Same 6-K as the US$12B row.
